events.title: 2026 south-west monsoon ends 12.6% below normal (87% of LPA), driest since 2015
events.description: IMD: June-Sept rainfall 759.4 mm vs 868.6 mm LPA (1971-2020), i.e. 87% of LPA / -12.6%. Lowest since 2015 (758.2 mm); fourth-lowest since 2001. Monthly: June 65% of normal, July ~101% (central India +33%), August 84%, September 92.4%. East and North-East India recorded its driest monsoon since 1901 (1,017.1 mm). 282 districts (38%) deficient; 15 states below normal; drought declared in parts of Maharashtra and Karnataka; South peninsula ~-23% by 28 Sep. IMD had forecast 92% of LPA (13 Apr) cut to 90% (29 May), so the aggregate was anticipated but June was far worse than forecast. Strong El Nino in progress (IMD 30 Sep: strong El Nino over equatorial Pacific, expected to strengthen through end-2026 and peak ~Nov); Indian Ocean Dipole neutral, i.e. no positive-IOD offset.
